steps.description: independent4096 ordinary2000ms fresh original material vs fixed finalist,block256ABBA; once only
archive full comparison and gate >=2pp/paired95lower>0/ops0; never retune from test
argv:
import datetime,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
d=Path('.local/evaluation/final-heldout-4096-v1');a=json.loads((d/'baseline.json').read_text());b=json.loads((d/'candidate.json').read_text());c=json.loads((d/'comparison.json').read_text())
for x in [a,b]:
 assert x['complete'] and x['measured']==4096 and x['total']==4096 and len(x['details'])==4096
 assert x['backend']=='86box' and x['mode']=='fixed_byoyomi' and x['milliseconds']==2000 and x['nodes'] is None
 assert all(x[k]==0 for k in ['errors','illegal_moves','time_overruns'])
 assert x['options']['Threads']==1 and x['options']['USI_Hash']==2 and x['options']['NetworkDelay']==0 and x['options']['NetworkDelay2']==0 and x['options']['MaxMovesToDraw']==512 and x['options']['EnteringKingRule']=='CSARule27'
assert c['comparison_operational_pass']
with Path('results/2026-11-07/final-heldout-4096-v1-comparison.json').open('x') as out:out.write((d/'comparison.json').read_text())
passed=c['difference']>=.02 and c['bootstrap_95']['lower']>0
r={'complete':True,'adoption_pass':passed,'verified_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'positions':4096,'baseline_matches':a['matches'],'candidate_matches':b['matches'],'difference_pp':c['difference']*100,'paired95_pp':{k:v*100 for k,v in c['bootstrap_95'].items()},'comparison_sha256':hashlib.sha256((d/'comparison.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'no_retuning_after_test':True,'scope':'one independent test of fixed model/runtime vs fresh original material; not an Elo estimate'}
with Path('results/2026-11-07/final-heldout-4096-v1-adoption-gate.json').open('x') as out:json.dump(r,out,indent=2);out.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(r))
if not passed:raise RuntimeError('heldout adoption gate not met; preserve results, do not retune or deploy')

policy: ModelD42 fixed before10JST. Runtime freeze must actually complete by15JST and select the expected qualified radix profile; preflight refuses any discrepancy before heldout. No test use for retuning/reselection. Full4096 original material freshly measured, never saved development baseline. No extraheavy/native/build/otherVM/training during timing; only the two calibrated VMs inside actualgame runner are concurrent. Keep measurement HEAD/code/plans/images fixed through validation. If any gate/step fails preserve state/log/results and stop, no automatic overwrite/restart. Deployment/default image remains unchanged until adoption and real operation pass; then backup+atomic switch and actual defaultUSI/restart checks separately.
